exceptions.reason: QUIC uninitialized stack bytes in peer detection. OpenSSL 3.6.5 is assumed affected, since it shares this code with 3.5 and 4.0. Not reached: the Windows build links OpenSSL only as SQLCipher's crypto provider (libsqlite3-sys 0.40.0 links libcrypto alone, never libssl), and that provider calls only AES-256-CBC, HMAC-SHA1/256/512, PBKDF2-HMAC and RAND. Checked 2026-11-22 in the SQLCipher 4.20.0 it compiles (sqlcipher-src 420.0.0's sqlcipher.c), which calls the same OpenSSL functions as the 4.14.0 checked on 2026-11-19: QUIC is in libssl, which isn't linked.
